newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH INSURER TO START QUOTING TEL INTEREST RATES.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH INSURER TO START QUOTING TEL INTEREST RATES.

text.p: Finnish insurer Garantia Oy said in a statement on Friday it would start to calculate and publish daily quotations of so called TEL relending interest rates derived from government benchmark bond yields.

Earlier, the ministry of trade and industry said it had decided, upon a request from work pension companies, to link the interest rate on loans to companies by the pension funds to government benchmark bond yields instead of an administratively fixed rate; up to now 5.50 percent.

Garantia, which specialises in guaranteeing pension fund investments, said it would quote reference rates for TEL relending based on the yields on five government bonds maturing between 1999 and 2006, and on the six Helibor market rates.
It said it expected annual TEL-relending volumes to increase to five billion markka from 2.5 billion in 1996.
In 1992, when market interest rates were high and the administrative TEL-relending rate low in comparison, companies borrowed 18 billion markka from work pension funds, Garantia said.
Based on April 9 bond yields, annual interest on TEL loans would have been between 3.00 percent on a three-year loan and 5.60 percent on a 10-year loan, it said.
Garantiais owned by Finnish work pension institutions. --Helsinki newsroom +358-9-680 50 245, e-mail news@reuters.fi
